questions.question: In Spring AOP, what is a pointcut?
options: The extra code that runs around a method
A rule that selects which method calls get advice
The class that holds all the advice
questions.explanation: A pointcut is the matching rule. The advice is the code, and the aspect is the class that holds it.

questions.question: Which starter adds Spring AOP support in Spring Boot 4?
questions.explanation: The old aop starter was renamed to spring-boot-starter-aspectj in Spring Boot 4.

questions.question: A @Before advice prints 'A', the target method prints 'B', and an @AfterReturning advice prints 'C'. In what order does the console show them for a successful call?
questions.explanation: Before advice runs first, then the method, then after-returning advice once the method has returned normally.

questions.question: The target method throws IllegalArgumentException. Which of these advices still runs?
questions.explanation: @AfterThrowing runs when the method throws. @AfterReturning is skipped because the method did not return normally.

questions.question: An @Around advice prints a log line and returns null, but the service method never runs and callers get null. What is the bug?
questions.explanation: In @Around advice the real method runs only when you call ProceedingJoinPoint.proceed().
